title: Design System: Pramaan Builder, Tape and Thread

digits.purpose: Engraved metric numerals; pure digits and a unit only.

heading.purpose: Section, card, panel and document h2.

body.purpose: UI text, table cells, status sentences.

label.purpose: Buttons, rail items, tape labels, pin labels.

motion.name: layout
motion.purpose: Rail collapse, tape pin slide, panel dock.

components.name: Thread Button
components.description: The one canary element per screen: the next decision.
components.css: .ds-btn-thread { height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--pm-sys-text); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--pm-sys-thread); color: var(--pm-sys-on-thread); font: 600 14px/16px 'Schibsted Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-thread:hover { background: var(--pm-sys-thread-hover); } .ds-btn-thread:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pm-sys-focus); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--pm-sys-focus-halo); }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary action with a control-border stroke.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--pm-sys-control-border); border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--pm-sys-text); font: 500 14px/16px 'Schibsted Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: var(--pm-sys-surface-sunken); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pm-sys-focus); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--pm-sys-focus-halo); }

components.name: Status Pin
components.description: Pin head, fixed label, one plain sentence. Shown: Done.
components.html: DoneThis is finished and saved.
components.css: .ds-pin { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--pm-sys-status-done); font: 500 14px/16px 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-pin-head { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--pm-sys-status-done); } .ds-pin-label { white-space: nowrap; } .ds-pin-sentence { color: var(--pm-sys-text-muted); font-weight: 400; font-size: 15px; line-height: 22px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat raised surface with a hairline; hover darkens the border.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--pm-sys-hairline); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--pm-sys-surface-raised); color: var(--pm-sys-text); transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--pm-sys-control-border); } .ds-card-name { font: 600 17px/24px 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-meta { color: var(--pm-sys-text-muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.01em; }

components.name: Engraved Digit
components.description: Sunken tabular numeral block with label and plain sentence.
components.css: .ds-digit { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 104px 1fr; align-items: center; column-gap: 16px; height: 72px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--pm-sys-hairline); } .ds-digit-value { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 52px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--pm-sys-surface-sunken); box-shadow: inset -1px -1px 0 var(--pm-sys-hairline); font: 600 28px/52px 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; } .ds-digit-text { color: var(--pm-sys-text-muted); font-size: 15px; line-height: 22px; }

components.name: Tape Journey Rail
components.description: Stitched baseline with ticks, step labels and a you-are-here pin.
components.css: .ds-tape { display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: auto; height: 40px; min-width: 360px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--pm-sys-hairline) 0 6px, transparent 6px 10px); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: 100% 1px; background-position: 0 calc(100% - 8px); font: 500 14px/16px 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tape li { position: relative; padding: 0 8px 0 9px; color: var(--pm-sys-text-muted); } .ds-tape li::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 8px; width: 2px; height: 8px; background: var(--pm-sys-text); } .ds-tape .ds-done { color: var(--pm-sys-text); } .ds-tape .ds-done::before { background: var(--pm-sys-status-done); } .ds-tape .ds-cur { color: var(--pm-sys-text); font-weight: 600; } .ds-tape .ds-lock { color: var(--pm-sys-status-locked); }

narrative.overview: A made-to-measure fitting, not a dashboard. The founder walks into a room where the work is pinned up in order, one measuring tape shows where the garment stands, and one thread is held out: the next thing only they can decide. The tailoring lives in the visuals and never in the words. Operate mode, non-technical founder, desktop only. The replaced look (cream and sage with a serif display) is the anti-reference.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained neutral ink ground, one committed canary, one cool chalk slate for annotation.
Flat surfaces separated by 1px hairlines and a stitched dashed seam; shadows only on floating layers.
One family for text (Schibsted Grotesk), mono only for ids and log lines.
Status is a pin head plus a fixed word plus one plain sentence, never colour alone.
One scroll per screen; the top bar and rail never scroll.

rules.name: The One Thread Rule
rules.body: Exactly one element per screen is filled canary, and it is the next decision. If nothing needs the founder there is no thread; the slot shows a pin and a status sentence and main declares data-thread-none.

rules.name: The Paper Not Cream Rule
rules.body: Neutrals stay cool and near-achromatic. Tinting the ground warm returns the anti-reference.

rules.name: The Status Is Never Only Colour Rule
rules.body: A status is always pin shape, fixed word and colour together.

rules.name: The Proportional Prose Rule
rules.body: Meta, Body and Label are proportional. Tabular figures are opt-in for column contexts only.

rules.name: The Seven Steps Rule
rules.body: No new size or weight. Table-header uppercase is a column-header device only.

rules.name: The Flat At Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards, panels and bars carry no shadow at rest. A hover changes border colour, never lifts.

dos: Do fill exactly one element canary per screen: the next decision.
Do show a pin and a plain sentence in the slot when nothing needs the founder, and declare data-thread-none on main.
Do keep every screen to one h1, one scroll, and a main job that starts near the top.
Do use only the seven status pins with fixed labels, each followed by one plain sentence.
Do name actions by their consequence and give any disabled control a visible reason.
Do put engineering facts under Details and add a one-line gloss under working-term headings.
Do use only --pm-sys-* and --pm-cmp-* in components; colour literals live only in tokens.css.
donts: Don't use cream, warm tints or a serif display.
Don't dress navigation or housekeeping as the thread.
Don't add heroes, eyebrows or kickers, marketing bands, or explainer panels wider than 320px.
Don't signal status by colour alone or invent an eighth status.
Don't use tabular figures in prose or an eighth type size.
Don't put a shadow on cards or bars at rest, or add a coloured side stripe.
Don't use em-dashes in UI copy, or the word Reject.
Don't nest scrollers, or let the rail or top bar scroll.
